name: guards
description: Keeps AI credit out of commits, PRs, issues, comments and releases, and stops the streaming CI log watcher, by reading each command instead of scanning its raw text.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: never blocks, logs what it would block (and what the guard scripts blocked) to mods-data/guards/decisions.jsonl. enforce: blocks.

mentionRepos.title: Repos that may name the product
mentionRepos.description: Comma-separated repo folder names (case-insensitive, e.g. "my-cli-plugin, docs-site") whose subject is Claude Code itself, so commit, PR and branch text there may name the product. "*" (the default) allows the plain product name everywhere, as the toolkit's attribution rule does (no credit, mentions are fine); a list narrows it to those repos; empty blocks it in every repo. AI credit lines stay blocked everywhere.
